data_dictionary.none_state: NONE means the strategic base is destroyed or demolished and has not been rebuilt by either faction; it is effectively no-man's-land.
data_dictionary.rate_trends: Adjacent equal-window comparison. Array order is [recent_per_hour, previous_per_hour, change_per_hour, direction].
data_dictionary.recent_events: A direct ownership flip can produce a loss row plus a capture row for the same state transition.
data_dictionary.selected_metrics: Evidence citation keys whose values and observation times are frozen at prediction time.
data_dictionary.total_enlistments: Cumulative unique players who have deployed to this region during the war. A player can count in multiple regions. This is not current population or a faction split; its change is only a new-to-that-region activity proxy.

previous_model_summary.headline: Godcrofts and Stonecradle Lead Overnight Strongpoint Exchanges
previous_model_summary.war_summary: Since the earlier watch, Godcrofts has kept the fastest pace, recording six strategic-base changes in the latest two-hour tally and fifty-six over the past day. Stonecradle stays lively with three changes in the same window; World's End has been the most worked strongpoint there. Stlican Shelf adds two further changes and now shows no neutral strongpoints, with Fort Hoarfrost the busiest position. Weathered Expanse has logged no fresh strategic-base change since midnight, yet its two-hour casualty count remains enormous, and Mooring County likewise shows heavy losses and enlistments, though no fresh strategic-base change has been listed in the latest two-hour window. Fisherman's Row, prominent in the last dispatch, has gone quiet, while Linn Mercy shows renewed movement in the six-hour figures. The war is still undecided, with strongpoints changing hands chiefly in Godcrofts, Stlican, and Stonecradle.
